criteria.UAPP-AC-01: Only the frozen unified app candidate is entered; protected existing assets and applications do not drift.
criteria.UAPP-AC-02: The user uses one application with natural language and inputs={}; no internal routing field is supplied.
criteria.UAPP-AC-03: The complete story produces real task-scoped artifacts, simulated publication, feedback, and next cycle in sequence.
criteria.UAPP-AC-04: All six professional capabilities are independently reachable from the same entrance.
criteria.UAPP-AC-05: Each capability case executes only the applicable capability; no fixed full-chain or dark run.
criteria.UAPP-AC-06: A real missing-condition case stops precisely and continues in the same conversation after the user supplies the gap.
criteria.UAPP-AC-07: Withdrawal changes future reuse eligibility without pretending to alter real or historical publication; side effects are test-scoped.
criteria.UAPP-AC-08: Plain, YAML/quoted, and JSON-like equivalents behave consistently, while the real missing-item negative is not released.
criteria.UAPP-AC-09: Multi-turn state, correction propagation, local recovery, and idempotency remain true on the frozen current candidate.
criteria.UAPP-AC-10: User-visible output is natural and contains no internal state, node, application, JSON, or acceptance vocabulary.
criteria.UAPP-AC-11: Every result is traceable to frozen input, run_id, node execution, graph/provider identity, M2 rows, and exact evidence file.

decision_rules.pass: All applicable UAPP-AC-01..11 are PASS/CURRENT, p0_failures=0, actual runs and attempts stay within the frozen budget, and protected surfaces do not drift.
decision_rules.first_hard_failure: Stop, retain RAW, perform FAILURE TRIAGE, do not repair, rerun, or start Prompt 2/3.
